result.stdout:
Usage: assembly-differ diff <first> <second> [options]

   Compares and diffs assemblies from different sources, outputting differences in XML, Markdown, or AsciiDoc.

Arguments:
  <first>   Old assembly provider: assembly|<path>, directory|<path>, nuget|<id>|<version>|[tfm],
previous-nuget|<id>|<version>|[tfm], or github|<owner/repo>|<commit>|<build command>|<relative output path>.
  <second>  New assembly provider, same format as first.

Global options:
  -h, --help                        Show help.

Options:
  -t, --target <values>             [repeatable] The assembly targets. Defaults to *all* assemblies located by the provider. May be
given more than once. [default: null]
  -f, --format <string>             The format of the diff output: xml, markdown, or asciidoc. [default: xml]
  -o, --output <string>             The output directory or file name. If not specified only prints to console. [default: null]
  -p, --prevent-change <string>     Fail if the change detected is higher than specified: none, patch, minor,
or major. Defaults to none, which never fails. [default: none]
  -a, --allow-empty-previous-nuget  Don't fail when no previous nuget package could be found to diff against.
